'''Death Star II Closed Environment''' is [[Decipher]]'s name for a constructed Star Wars CCG format of 2000 in which both decks use only [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] and [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] cards, plus the other cards printed in the [[Death Star II Starter Decks]]. Decipher introduced it at [[DecipherCon 2000]] as "this new tournament environment".<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref> The [[Players Committee]]'s Alternate Format Tournament Guide calls the same card pool the '''Battle of Endor Environment'''.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Also called:''' Battle of Endor Environment (Players Committee)
* '''Type:''' constructed, closed environment
* '''Card pool:''' Endor, Death Star II, and the Death Star II Starter Deck reprints
* '''GEMP:''' no constructed format; [[Endor - Death Star II Sealed]] is the sealed version of the pool

== Card pool ==

Decks are built from three sources:<ref name="afg" />
# cards with the [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] expansion icon;
# cards with the [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] expansion icon;
# any card in the [[Death Star II Starter Decks]], even one from another expansion. These are:

{| class="wikitable"
! Dark Side !! Light Side
|-
| [[Reserve Pilot]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Dark Maneuvers]] (Premiere)<br>[[Flawless Marksmanship]] (Special Edition)<br>[[Ghhhk]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Imperial Reinforcements]] (Premiere)<br>[[Monnok]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]] (Premiere)<br>[[Black 3]] (Premiere)<br>[[TIE Defender Mark I]] (Special Edition)<br>[[Victory-Class Star Destroyer]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Blaster Rifle (Dark)|Blaster Rifle]] (Premiere)<br>[[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Intruder Missile (Dark)|Intruder Missile]] (Special Edition)
| [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian]] (Hoth)<br>[[A Few Maneuvers]] (Premiere)<br>[[Grimtaash]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Houjix]] (A New Hope)<br>[[Steady Aim]] (Special Edition)<br>[[Bespin]] (Cloud City)<br>[[Tatooine (Light) (Premiere)|Tatooine]] (Premiere)<br>[[X-wing]] (Premiere)<br>[[Y-wing]] (Premiere)<br>[[Intruder Missile]] (Special Edition)
|}

The guide adds that the format can also be played as sealed deck: each player gets a Death Star II starter deck plus Endor and Death Star II boosters to draft from.<ref name="afg" />

== Events ==

* [[2000 DecipherCon Death Star II Closed Environment]]: Decipher's sanctioned "Death Star II Closed Environment Constructed" side event at DecipherCon 2000, scheduled three times (5, 6 and 7 October 2000, 4 games each).<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />
